explication: Velero is a Kubernetes backup, restore, and cluster-migration system with a local CLI and an in-cluster server. The main workflow is to request a backup, capture cluster resources and persistent-volume data, store backup artifacts, then request a restore that recreates resources and recovers volume data. Scheduling, deletion, and plugin-driven storage or resource actions are important supporting capabilities. The README establishes the product workflow; the tree identifies the major subsystems, but sampled source is limited, so several internal connections are intentionally omitted.
